statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains well below the block threshold at 11% while Stress is elevated at 58%.
recommendation: Conditions are characterised by a contained two-sided Nasdaq-100 price path against an elevated macro backdrop of cycle-high Treasury yields and Hormuz-driven crude strength. The narrow 13:30-15:00 UTC window around the US cash open and the simultaneous ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS releases is the identified conditional risk concentration.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold a narrow overnight band near 29,545 while the 10-year yield extends to 4.784% and crude pushes toward $87
body: NQ futures trade near 29,545.50, about +0.11%, inside an overnight band of 29,434.75-29,570.00 that has not extended in the past hour. The roughly 135-point range has been worked repeatedly in both directions, with no observed directional efficiency, no shallow-pullback sequence and no repeated extension after failed retracements. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed August 31 at 29,456.97, up 0.08%, after recovering from a session low of 29,304.49 - mean reversion functioned through Monday's session. VIX is unchanged at 14.92, low in absolute terms, and E-mini S&P 500 futures are effectively flat. The macro backdrop, not the price path, is the source of Stress. The 10-year Treasury yield has extended to 4.784%, up 0.028 on the day and the highest since January 2025, with the 2-year at 4.37%; the latest Federal Reserve H.15 release still reflects August 28 at 4.73% and 4.34%. Market pricing for a 25 basis-point hike at the September FOMC has firmed to roughly 65%, up from about 57-60% after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's August 28 Jackson Hole address was read as hawkish. Energy adds a second layer: after US strikes on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian retaliation against bases in Jordan and the UAE, WTI has extended to about $86.99 (+1.44%) and Brent to roughly $91.64 (+1.27%). The notable feature of this hour is a conflict rather than an alignment: yields, crude and hike odds are all extending in a risk-negative direction while the index itself holds flat. Under the applied framework a conflict of that kind raises Stress and lowers conviction rather than raising Tail, because the pathological no-retracement path has not been observed. Delayed cross-asset context shows semiconductors uniformly firmer in the latest session against a megacap group that is mostly lower, which is dispersion evidence rather than index-level one-way structure. Tail is therefore held at 11%, Stress raised to 58% for the extending rates and energy stack, and Confidence set at 87% on verified current levels, yields, crude, volatility, event consensus figures and a verified calendar.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment and every one mapped to the EA_ON band. Tail ranged from 5 to 17 and Stress rose from the mid 30s to 56. The single Tail peak of 17 came in the 09:00 UTC hour on August 31 during a European event/whipsaw window, and dominant mode was mixed in 22 of the 24 hours with event/whipsaw only at 09:00 and 10:00 UTC. Through the US session Stress climbed steadily as crude extended on the Larak Island exchange, the 10-year yield pushed to its highest level since January 2025 and September rate-hike odds firmed after the Jackson Hole address, while Tail stayed compressed between 9 and 13 because the price path itself remained two-sided and mean-reverting. The overnight hours since Monday's cash close held that pattern with Stress at 50-56 and Tail at 9-11.
outlookSummary: The base case over the next 24 hours is continued contained, two-sided trade with an elevated-Stress, low-Tail profile. Conditional risk concentrates in the narrow 13:30-15:00 UTC danger window around the US cash open and the simultaneous 14:00 UTC ISM Manufacturing PMI and JOLTS releases, where forecast Tail peaks at 18 and Stress at 66 with dominant mode projected as event/whipsaw - still inside the EA_ON band. Risk is then projected to decay through the US afternoon as event volatility unwinds, with a small power-hour uptick into the 20:00 UTC cash close and a secondary dispersion checkpoint after it as Dell Technologies and Palo Alto Networks report. The path then eases to its 24-hour low overnight before firming modestly into the September 2 European session ahead of ADP. Every forecast hour maps to EA_ON. The projection would be invalidated by observed persistent one-way structure, shallow or failed retracements, NQ holding near session extremes, or a fresh geopolitical discontinuity in the Strait of Hormuz.
